title: share.accrued payload v1
description: B4 Uni's revenue share on one payment the school collected, booked when the payment is: share is the amount collected times percent over 100, rounded half up to whole cents. The rate in force is written here, so a later change of the rate leaves this event as it was.

payment_id.description: The id of the payment.succeeded this is for: an invoice id (in_...) or a booking's payment intent id (pi_...).

collected.description: What the payment collected, before Stripe's fee (cents).

percent.description: The school's rate when the payment was booked, at most two decimals.

share.description: The share accrued (cents): at least 1 and at most collected.
